statement: Chen is the registered Logistics Coordinator in the Supply Cell.
The Logistics Coordinator plans warehouse-to-field movement and maintains dispatch status.
Chen says he does not approve purchases.
Purchases at or above 5,000 credits require Regional Finance Officer approval under the supplied policy.
Chen is a useful routing target for dispatch planning/status questions.
Chen should not be represented as the owner of stock accuracy.
notes: Participant correction rejects an over-broad preliminary placement; supplied corpus does not identify a single owner of stock accuracy.
